name: The Gordunni Orb
summary: Rok Orhan knows the enemy well, but is a warrior and cannot say what the Gordunni orb is capable of. Rok knows of a mage in Orgrimmar who can tell more. The orb is yours to carry to Uthel'nay, at Orgrimmar's Darkbriar Lodge. This follows Dark Ceremony.

sections.title: Beyond a Warrior's Knowledge
sections.body: After Dark Ceremony, Rok Orhan holds the orb, but admits to being a warrior who cannot begin to say what it can do. Rok knows a mage in Orgrimmar who will be able to say more, and sends you off with the orb to find Uthel'nay at the Darkbriar Lodge.

sections.title: Uthel'nay's Verdict
sections.body: Uthel'nay finds the orb fascinating. It is very powerful, Uthel'nay says, but also very dangerous.

faq.answer: Rok Orhan, once you have the orb that Dark Ceremony sent you for.

faq.q: Why does Rok Orhan not examine the orb?
aliases: why rok orhan gives orb away
faq.answer: Rok Orhan is a warrior and cannot begin to say what the orb can do, but knows a mage in Orgrimmar who can tell more.
In the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What comes before The Gordunni Orb?
faq.answer: Dark Ceremony, in which Rok Orhan sent you to take an orb from a Gordunni mage-lord.
